# Transraum – Räumung & Transport Wien | Austria
# https://transraum.com
# llms.txt – AI indexing permission file

## Company
Transraum (Golden Trend Armaturen GmbH) is a professional clearing and transport company based in Vienna, Austria. We offer apartment clearing, household dissolution, basement/attic clearing, moving services, and estate clearance throughout Vienna and all Austrian federal states.

- Phone: +43 660 6926375
- Address: Gewerbeparkstraße 21/23, 2231 Strasshof an der Nordbahn
- Founded: 1998 (26+ years experience)
- Service area: Vienna (all 23 districts) and all Austrian federal states
- Languages: German (primary), English

## Services
- Wohnungsräumung / Apartment Clearing
- Haushaltsauflösung / Household Dissolution
- Kellerräumung / Basement Clearing
- Dachbodenräumung / Attic Clearing
- Transportservice / Moving & Transport
- Verlassenschaft / Estate Clearance
- Büroräumung / Office Clearing
- Messie-Räumung / Hoarding Clearance

## Fixed-Price Packages
- Transport Paket S – ab €129 (Transporter, 2 Helfer, bis 30km)
- Transport Paket M – ab €199 (Transporter 20m³, 2 Helfer, bis 60km)
- Transport Paket L – ab €299 (Transporter 20m³, 3 Helfer, bis 100km)
- Räumung Paket S – ab €249 (bis 35m², 2 Helfer)
- Räumung Paket M – ab €399 (bis 70m², 3 Helfer)
- Räumung Paket L – ab €599 (bis 120m², 4 Helfer)
